show.description: When elite intelligence officer Major Rudra Pratap Singh uncovers a covert threat to national security, he must lead Operation Queen Fall—a high-risk mission to dismantle an international espionage ring led by the enigmatic and deadly Aaliya Raza. As betrayals surface and loyalties are tested, Rudra races against time to stop a catastrophe that could rewrite global power dynamics.
